items.author: @renee.whitlock
items.title: DM with Renee Whitlock
items.body: Coach, good luck tonight. Admin team meets Monday at noon and our principal Dr. Pruitt wants a few wins from each program for the board report. Send me your rundown before then. Game, playoff situation, booster stuff, anything academic. I'll pull from whatever you give me.

items.author: @marcus.reed
items.title: Friday final
items.body: FINAL: Vulcan Ridge 31, Brookhollow 14. Deshawn Pettaway 3 sacks, 7 tackles. Tavion Hurst 188 yds rushing, 2 TD. Defense held them to 46 yds rushing second half. That locks up 2nd in the region. Film uploaded to the drive.

items.author: @lyle.danner
items.title: playoff draw
items.body: AHSAA posted brackets. We host Clanton Valley first round, Friday Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. Gate crew and chain crew need confirming by Wednesday. Ticket office says presale starts Tuesday.

items.author: @tonya.greer
items.title: 9 week grade check
items.body: Grade check is in for the 9 weeks. All 52 kids on the roster eligible. Nobody on the list. Study hall Tuesdays and Thursdays is paying off. Gonna keep it going thru the playoffs.

items.author: @carla.mims
items.title: Boston butt sale final count
items.body: Final count on the Boston butt sale is in y'all!! 208 butts sold, $6,240 raised. Goal was $4,500. Money goes toward the new sideline headsets like we talked about. Huge thanks to Hargrove's Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

items.author: @marcus.reed
items.title: DM with Marcus Reed
items.body: Coach keep this between us for now. I interviewed Thursday with Lakeshore Christian for their defensive coordinator opening. They said they'd decide after Thanksgiving. Not saying I'm leaving, just didn't want you hearing it from somebody else. Please don't mention it to Renee yet.

items.author: @janelle.ortiz
items.title: gym floor
items.body: Reminder the main gym floor gets refinished Nov 16-20. All PE classes outside or in the aux gym that week. Rain plan is the cafeteria after 2nd lunch.

items.author: @front.office
items.title: Picture retakes
items.body: Picture day retakes are Thursday Nov 12 in the library. Send students during homeroom only please.

items.author: @renee.whitlock
items.title: DM with Renee Whitlock
items.body: Also if we make it, transportation needs any bus requests for playoff away games 5 days out. Just keep that in mind.

items.body: Faculty meeting moved to Wednesday 3:30 in the library this week due to the board report. Sign in sheet at the door.
